source:
This is a major update to Soundscape.

Travel mode is much improved. When you travel by car or bus, Soundscape now calls out road numbers, your direction of travel, and nearby settlements. It also calls out when you cross rivers, canals, firths, and bays. Please update your offline maps to get these new features. Bus stop descriptions are now much better for users in the UK.

Sleep mode can now wake automatically when it detects that you are moving again. You no longer need to remember to wake it yourself.

We reorganized the underlying code so that we can build an iOS app from the same code. This means that in the future, we can release an iOS app with all of the features we have built for Android.

Please continue to report any problems, however small, through Contact Support in the main menu.
current: Det här är en stor uppdatering av Soundscape. Reseläget är mycket bättre. När du reser med bil eller buss läser Soundscape nu upp vägnummer, din färdriktning och närliggande orter. Appen läser också upp när du korsar floder, kanaler, fjordar och vikar. Uppdatera dina offlinekartor för att få dessa nya funktioner. Beskrivningarna av busshållplatser är nu mycket bättre för användare i Storbritannien. Viloläget kan nu vakna automatiskt när det upptäcker att du rör dig igen. Du behöver inte längre komma ihåg att väcka det själv. Vi har omstrukturerat den underliggande koden så att vi kan bygga en iOS-app från samma kod. Det innebär att vi i framtiden kan släppa en iOS-app med alla funktioner vi har byggt för Android. Fortsätt gärna rapportera eventuella problem, hur små de än är, via alternativet Kontakta supporten i huvudmenyn.

source: Soundscape is ready for Gemini, but Gemini cannot use it yet: that depends on Google releasing support for Android app functions in Gemini. Once it does, you will be able to ask Gemini to do things in Soundscape without touching your phone: hear a callout, start one of your routes, or set an audio beacon on one of your markers. Any other assistant that supports Android app functions will be able to do the same.\n\nSoundscape will answer in its own voice, with the callouts and beacon sounds you already know, rather than the assistant reading out a summary. That way what you hear will still come from the direction it is describing.

Alla andra assistenter som stöder appfunktioner i Android kommer att kunna göra samma sak.\n\nSoundscape kommer att svara med sin egen röst, med de informationsljud och fyrljud du redan känner till, i stället för att assistenten läser upp en sammanfattning. På så sätt kommer det du hör fortfarande från den riktning som beskrivs.

source:
You acknowledge that Soundscape (1) is not designed, intended, or made available as a medical device, and (2) is not designed or intended to be a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, or judgment and should not be used to replace or as a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, or judgment.

Safety Notice

Soundscape is a navigation aid and should not be used in lieu of mobility skills, being aware of your surroundings, and good judgement. Use caution when navigating your environment as the mapping data incorporated into the Soundscape program is captured from a third-party program, and therefore, there may be limitations with the accuracy of the information presented.

«tills» is a temporal conjunction ('until [time]'); a distance to a street needs «till» ('125 m till 32nd Street').
«sedan» is temporal ('since [time]'); distance travelled from a street reads «125 m från 32nd Street».
«1,6 km sedan Westerton» uses temporal «sedan» for a distance; «1,6 km från Westerton» is natural.
Button moves the simulated position to the next intersection; «OK» sounds like a confirmation button, not 'Go'.

source: As with all four of the buttons at the bottom of the home screen, hold your phone with the screen flat (facing towards the sky) and the top of the phone pointing in the direction you are facing before you press the *Around Me* button. This acts like a compass telling the app which direction you are facing. Simply, tap the *Around Me* button and you will hear four points of interest arranged around you.

source: You can access certain features in Soundscape with the help of the media control buttons on your headphones. This functionality works with any wired or Bluetooth headphones that have media control buttons like Play, Pause, Next, Previous and others. Different headphones may include different buttons so please refer to the list of actions below to determine which ones are available to you.

Använd listan med åtgärder nedan för att ta reda vilka som finns.

source: Soundscape can determine the location of your destination to within several meters, but not less. When Soundscape determines that you are close to your destination, you will hear a final callout that your destination is nearby, and the beacon will turn off.

source: Soundscape is designed to help fill in details about your environment that you may not be aware of otherwise. While it is not designed as a turn-by-turn navigation app, it can be used alongside such apps to provide complementary information. To use Soundscape with these apps, start your navigation app first. Then, move over to Soundscape and set a beacon on the same destination as in the navigation app. At this point, both apps will be running and you will hear walking directions from your navigation app, while getting updates on points of interest, intersections, and your distance to your destination from Soundscape.

Android and iOS Swedish call this permission «Aviseringar»; «Meddelanden» is the Messages app/SMS.
English is deliberately lowercase because it is substituted mid-callout into osm_entrance_*_with_destination («Stormarknad huvudentré från Hills Road»).
OSM building=garages is a row of lock-up garages, not car repair workshops; «Bilverkstäder» is a different amenity (osm_car_repair is «Bilverkstad»).
A sally port is a historic fortification gate; «Säkerhetsport» ('security gate') suggests a modern access-control gate.

«Obevakad övergång» is the usual term for an unguarded railway level crossing; for a pedestrian crossing without signals Swedish uses «obevakat övergångsställe», matching osm_crossing «Övergångsställe».

shop=trade is a trade supplier (builders' merchant, plumbing/electrical supplies); «Handelsbutik» ('trade shop') is a calque that tells the listener nothing. «Byggvaruhandel» or «Grossist för hantverkare» are candidates; needs a native call.
«mile/miles» keeps the English plural, and a Swedish TTS voice may read «mile» as Swedish «mil» (10 km). «engelsk mil / engelska mil» is unambiguous but longer; worth a native decision.

«Markörer» departs from the confirmed term «platsmarkör» used everywhere else (help texts call this button *Platsmarkörer i närheten*). Forced by the 8-characters-per-line limit, so probably acceptable; flagged for a human look only.
«klinga» (as a noun) means 'blade'; 'ring sound' would be «klang» or «ringsignal». Probably Microsoft's wording (C14), so flagged for a native check rather than changed.
«vid 90 grader» is an odd way to say a bearing; «på %1$s grader» would parallel «på klockan %1$s». Low confidence, native check.
